title: KotlinMCUI-Backend (Port)
description: A port of KotlinMCUI-Backend by 2894638479 to modern versions.
body:
# KotlinMCUI-backend
This is a backend mod for the KotlinMCUI mod, which has been ported to 26.1+ versions. The mod KotlinMCUI and KotlinMCUI-backend are both made by **[2894638479](https://modrinth.com/user/2894638479)**

This mod is a library mod, it doesn't add anything by itself, it lets other mods add things easier.

## What it does

This mod acts as a connection between a mod that uses the frontend **[KotlinMCUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/kotlinmcui)** and another mod that uses the features added by it. I have not made any changes to it other than porting and fixing a few bugs.
